messages.subject: Masking by height from CHM
parts:
Hello, 

Is it possible to create a mask using the CHM instead of VI's? I'm analyzing trees in pasture and the VI's are not distinct enough to segment out the trees but the CHM is very defined. I would like to mask out all values under .25 meter from the CHM and use that as the mask for fieldMask.

Thanks,

Eric

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Masking by height from CHM
parts:
Hi Eric,

Thanks for asking, using CHM to make mask is one point in my list of upgrades. I will try to do it as soon as possible and get back to you... ok

For now, you can make a simple mask by using a code like this:

mask<-CHM>5

In this case all pixels with height greater than 5m will be selected as TRUE (1) and others FALSE (0). On the next following steps, you will need to inform the parameter value=1. For example, on the fieldCount().

Let us know if it works... Hope it helps...! 

All the best,
Filipe
